name: Gitea
description: Give agents Git access to repositories on a Gitea or Forgejo instance.

methods.label: Access token
methods.whenToUse: Use an access token for clone, fetch, and push on one Gitea or Forgejo instance.
methods.guidanceMd: In Gitea, open Settings → Applications and generate a token with `read:user` and read/write `repository` permissions. Choose a dedicated agent to give one agent its own Gitea identity.

tenantFields.label: Gitea URL
tenantFields.helperMd: Use the HTTPS address of your Gitea or Forgejo instance, for example `https://gitea.com` or `https://codeberg.org`. A repository link or clone URL from the instance also works.

warnings: Shell Git receives this token for the Gitea host during the run and is not constrained by per-tool Ask-first controls.
